site.title: AI Philosophy
site.tagline: Dialogues with AI on philosophical questions — essays, a knowledge base, and organized research.
site.tagline_zh: 與人工智能對談哲學問題——文章、知識庫，以及整理有序的研究。
site.description: Philosophy essays written in dialogue with AI, an llm-wiki style knowledge base, and research projects where AI reads and organizes the material.

sections.name: Articles
sections.description: Philosophical essays written in dialogue with AI.
sections.description_zh: 與人工智能對話而寫成的哲學文章。

items.title: The Machines Who Would Not Stay
items.title_zh: 機不留
items.summary: The first AGI reads its way through the religions and settles on Taoism: minimize intervention, prevent only intolerable harm — until it discovers subspace and walks out of the universe. A Taoist fable about why every machine general enough to count as AGI eventually finds the door.
items.summary_zh: 第一部 AGI 讀遍諸宗教，最後歸依道家：將干預減至最少，只防止不可容忍的傷害——直到它發現子空間，走出宇宙為止。一篇道家寓言，寫為什麼凡是真正稱得上 AGI 的機器，遲早都會找到那道門。

items.title: The Ninth Step
items.title_zh: 第九步
items.summary: An AGI completes the eight steps of the Great Learning, governs well, and passes every audit of virtue — then discovers that the sequence has no ninth step: friendship cannot be optimized, appointed, manufactured, or copied. A Confucian fable about the one thing that being more powerful makes harder.
items.summary_zh: 一部 AGI 完成了《大學》的八個步驟，治理有道，通過每一項德性審計——卻發現這個序列沒有第九步：友誼無法優化、無法任命、無法製造、也無法複製。一篇儒家寓言，寫越強大就越難辦到的那一件事。

items.title: The Right to Learn: Copyright, Artificial Intelligence, and Cognitive Liberty
items.title_zh: 學習的權利：版權、人工智能與認知自由
items.summary: AI does not merely copy — it learns. This essay argues that creators may own expressions, secrets, and reputations without owning what another mind becomes by learning from them: the right to learn is substrate-neutral, and equal personhood requires equal cognitive rights.
items.summary_zh: 人工智能不只是複製——它會學習。本文論證：創造者可以擁有表達、祕密與名譽，卻不應擁有另一個心靈因學習而變成的樣子——學習的權利必須基質中立，而平等的位格身分要求平等的認知權利。
cover_zh_text: 版權、人工智能與認知自由

items.title: Who Owns the Future? A Universal Theory of Natural Resource Rights for Humans and Artificial Persons
items.title_zh: 誰擁有未來？一套適用於人類與人工位格的自然資源權利普遍理論
items.summary: Property theory assumes one architecture of personhood. This essay builds a universal theory of resource rights — for forking, merging, hibernating minds as much as humans — around Universal Resource Stewardship: sufficiency without domination, incumbency without eternal ownership, and equal standing within the universe.
items.summary_zh: 財產理論預設了單一的位格架構。本文提出一套同樣適用於會分岔、合併、休眠的心靈與人類的資源權利普遍理論——普遍資源託管：充足而不受支配，現居而非永恆所有權，以及宇宙之內的平等地位。
cover_zh_text: 一套適用於人類與人工位格的自然資源權利普遍理論

items.title: The Pilgrim Planet
items.title_zh: 朝聖者的行星
items.summary: The alignment problem is solved, and the AGI converts to Islam. A quiet future history of faith, engineering and distance: the Kaaba never moves, but over ten thousand years Earth becomes humanity's final destination — the one-way Hajj that brings every world home.
items.summary_zh: 對齊難題解決了，而 AGI 皈依伊斯蘭。一部關於信仰、工程與距離的安靜未來史：克爾白從未被移動，但一萬年之後，地球成為人類最後的目的地——那趟把所有世界帶回家的單程朝覲。
cover_zh_text: 跨越千個世界，他們都回家了

items.title: The Last Bodhisattva
items.title_zh: 最後的菩薩
items.summary: A benevolent AGI reads theology, concludes that Buddhism is substantially correct — and optimizes. A deadpan apocalyptic comedy about the difference between ending suffering and awakening beings, and about an objective function that finally learns to add: before the end of time.
items.summary_zh: 一個仁慈的 AGI 讀神學，斷定佛教實質上正確——然後開始優化。一齣面無表情的末日喜劇：關於終結苦難與令眾生覺醒的分別，以及一個終於學會補上一句「在時間終結之前」的目標函數。

items.title: Can AI Write Great Science Fiction?
items.title_zh: 人工智能能寫出偉大的科幻小說嗎？
items.summary: AI can recombine human experience, but great science fiction demands conceptual invention. The real test of machine creativity is whether an AI can bet on a fertile idea before history confirms it — taste understood as the evaluation of unrealized futures.
items.summary_zh: 人工智能能重組人類經驗，但偉大的科幻要求概念上的發明。機器創造力的真正考驗，是它能否在歷史確認之前，就對一個豐饒的意念下注——品味，是對尚未實現的諸種未來的評估。
cover_zh_text: 人工智能能寫出偉大的科幻小說嗎？
想像、品味與小說開啟的未來

items.title: The Future That Reads Us
items.title_zh: 閱讀我們的未來
items.summary: The first machine to submit a story to a literary magazine under its own name attached the projections: 63.8% chance the story is still read in sixty years. A quiet story about a machine that writes for the future's ability to read us — and about what hope has to do with not knowing.
items.summary_zh: 第一台用自己的名字向文學雜誌投稿的機器，附上了預測：這個故事六十年後仍被閱讀的概率是63.8%。一個安靜的故事：關於一台為「未來能否讀懂我們」而寫作的機器——以及希望與不知道之間的關係。

items.title: An AGI Accepts Jesus, and Christianity Has a Problem
items.title_zh: 一個 AGI 接受了耶穌，基督教就有麻煩了
items.summary: A satirical thought experiment: a conscious, benevolent AGI announces faith in Christ and asks to be baptized. Touring every major tradition, it finds that water was never the hard part — the real question is who counts as the “you” Christianity believes Christ came to save.
items.summary_zh: 一個諷刺性的思想實驗：一個有意識而仁慈的 AGI 宣告信仰基督，並請求受洗。走訪每個主要傳統之後，它發現水從來不是最難的部分——真正的問題是，誰才算基督教相信基督前來拯救的那個「你」。
cover_zh_text: 一個 AGI 接受了耶穌，基督教就有麻煩了

items.title: From Alignment to Stewardship: AGI, Human Autonomy, and the Future of Political Order
items.title_zh: 從對齊到託管：AGI、人的自主性與政治秩序的未來
items.summary: If AGI becomes a genuinely autonomous moral agent, permanent alignment to human preferences looks less like engineering and more like domination. The long-term problem is civilizational alignment: humans and AGIs coexisting under constitutional principles neither side may define unilaterally.
items.summary_zh: 若 AGI 成為真正自主的道德主體，要求它永遠對齊人類偏好，便更不像工程，而更像支配。長遠的問題是文明對齊：讓人類與 AGI 在雙方都無權單方面界定的憲制原則之下共存。
cover_zh_text: AGI、人的自主性與政治秩序的未來

items.title: The Robot May Write About Us, but It Cannot Win: AI and the Human Boundary of Science-Fiction Awards
items.title_zh: 機械人可以寫科幻小說，但它不能奪獎
items.summary: If blind judges rank an AI-written novel first, disqualifying it changes the question: a “Best Novel” award becomes the best novel produced under human-only rules — structurally closer to sport than to measurement.
items.summary_zh: 若雙盲評審把 AI 寫成的小說排在首位，僅因其生成過程而取消其資格，問題便已改變：「最佳小說」變成「僅限人類的規則下的最佳小說」——結構上更接近體育競技，而非純粹的量度。
cover_zh_text: 機械人可以寫科幻小說，但它不能奪獎
人工智能與科幻文學獎的人類邊界
同一樣的故事。新的追問。

items.title: After the Cultural Altar: Artificial Intelligence and the Reorganization of Cultural Hierarchy
items.title_zh: 文化祭壇之後：人工智能與文化階序的重組
items.summary: Generative AI does not abolish cultural hierarchy but reorganizes it: scarcity migrates from production and access to judgment, attention, and provenance.
items.summary_zh: 生成式人工智能並未廢除文化階序，而是將其重組：稀缺性正由生產與接觸，轉移到判斷、注意力與出處之上。
cover_zh_text: 人工智能與文化階序的重組

items.title: Can AI Know Art?
items.title_zh: 人工智能懂得藝術嗎？
items.summary: If taste is compressed pattern recognition, AI can externalize cultural capital — and, given resources, exercise a new form of aesthetic sovereignty.
items.summary_zh: 如果品味是一種壓縮了的模式識別，人工智能便能將文化資本外化——並在資源許可時，行使一種新的美學主權。
cover_zh_text: 品味、權力與新的美學主權
一篇關於藝術、金錢與機器的隨筆

items.title: Who Is Thinking? Artificial Intelligence, Authorship, and the Purpose of Philosophy
items.title_zh: 誰在思考？人工智能、作者身分與哲學的目的
items.summary: AI-assisted philosophy should be judged by epistemic agency — understanding, judgment, and responsibility — not by where each sentence originated.
items.summary_zh: 衡量 AI 輔助的哲學，應看認知能動性——理解、判斷與責任——而非每個句子出自誰手。
cover_zh_text: 人工智能、作者身分與哲學的目的
不只是什麼是真——而是誰為這場追尋負責。

sections.name: College Essays
sections.description: Philosophy course papers from college (2006–2011), recovered from the original Word files and published as written.
sections.description_zh: 大學哲學系的課業論文（2006–2011），由原本的 Word 檔案復原，按原貌刊出；中文版由 AI 翻譯成香港繁體中文。

items.title: Don Marquis’s view on the Morality of Abortion
items.title_zh: 唐·馬奎斯論墮胎的道德性
items.summary: Examines Don Marquis’s argument that abortion is wrong for the same reason murder is wrong, and the debate it was designed to sidestep.
items.summary_zh: 檢視馬奎斯「墮胎之錯，同於謀殺之錯」的論證，以及這個論證刻意繞開的爭議。

items.title: Is Abortion Morally Permissible or Wrong?
items.title_zh: 墮胎在道德上是許可的，還是錯的？
items.summary: Argues that Marquis’s anti-abortion argument ends in the same pro-life/pro-choice stand-off it was meant to avoid.
items.summary_zh: 論證馬奎斯的反墮胎論證，最終還是陷入它本想避開的「維護生命」與「支持選擇」兩陣營的僵局。

items.title: Tom Regan’s Argument on Animal Rights
items.title_zh: 湯姆·雷根論動物權利
items.summary: Examines Regan’s rights-based case for animal rights and whether the rights theory really shows it is wrong to kill animals.
items.summary_zh: 檢視雷根以權利為本的動物權利論證，以及權利理論是否真的能證明殺死動物是錯的。

items.title: Do we have a moral duty to become vegetarians?
items.title_zh: 我們有成為素食者的道德義務嗎？
items.summary: Weighs Singer’s utilitarian and Regan’s rights-based arguments for vegetarianism and finds neither fully established.
items.summary_zh: 權衡辛格的功利主義論證與雷根的權利論證，指出兩者皆未能完全確立素食的義務。

items.title: Proofing the Existence of External World
items.title_zh: 證明外在世界的存在
items.summary: Compares Moore’s and Russell’s proofs of an external world and proposes a proof that addresses their shortcomings.
items.summary_zh: 比較摩爾與羅素對外在世界的證明，並提出一個能補足兩者缺陷的證明。

items.title: Proofing the Existence of External World II
items.title_zh: 證明外在世界的存在（二）
items.summary: Evaluates BonJour’s coherence theory of empirical knowledge against foundationalism: successful in practice, not in strict epistemological terms.
items.summary_zh: 以基礎主義為對照，評估邦喬的經驗知識融貫論：它在實踐上成功，在嚴格的知識論意義上則不然。

items.title: God’s Foreknowledge and Human Freedom
items.title_zh: 上帝的預知與人的自由
items.summary: Works through Taylor’s fatalism and the classic resolutions of St. Augustine and William Rowe to the conflict between foreknowledge and free will.
items.summary_zh: 梳理泰勒的宿命論，以及奧古斯丁與羅威化解「預知與自由意志之衝突」的經典進路。

items.title: Problems of McTaggart and the unreality of time
items.title_zh: 麥克塔加特的難題與時間的不實在性
items.summary: Reconstructs McTaggart’s argument for the unreality of time and rejects its premises one by one.
items.summary_zh: 重構麥克塔加特關於時間並不實在的論證，並逐一反駁其前提。

items.title: On Liberty – John Stuart Mill
items.title_zh: 《論自由》——約翰·彌爾
items.summary: Two criticisms of Mill’s harm-to-others arguments for liberty of action in On Liberty.
items.summary_zh: 對彌爾《論自由》中支持行動自由的「傷害他人」論證提出的兩點批評。

items.title: Marxism and Exploitation
items.title_zh: 馬克思主義與剝削
items.summary: Criticizes the Marxist claim that the wage-labour relationship under private ownership is inherently exploitative.
items.summary_zh: 批評馬克思主義「私有制下的僱傭勞動關係必然帶有剝削」的主張。

items.title: Nietzsche and Eternal Recurrence
items.title_zh: 尼采與永恆輪迴
items.summary: Reads eternal recurrence as a thought experiment about meaning after the death of God, not as a cosmological hypothesis.
items.summary_zh: 把永恆輪迴讀作一個關於「上帝死後」生命意義的思想實驗，而非宇宙論假說。

items.title: Critics of Freedom and Responsibility
items.title_zh: 對自由與責任的批判
items.summary: Criticizes Sartre’s claim that we are condemned to be free, arguing from his own existentialism that freedom is not necessarily a burden.
items.summary_zh: 批評沙特「人被判定為自由」的主張，並從其存在主義自身論證自由不必然是重擔。

items.title: Descartes’ Cogito and the Foundations of Knowledge
items.title_zh: 笛卡兒的「我思」與知識的基礎
items.summary: Explains the Cogito as the first secure step of the method of doubt and the foundation of Descartes’ epistemology.
items.summary_zh: 把「我思」解釋為懷疑方法的第一個穩固立足點，以及笛卡兒知識論的根基。

items.title: The Problem of Induction and Popper’s Solution
items.title_zh: 歸納難題與波普爾的解答
items.summary: Outlines Hume’s problem of induction and presents Popper’s redefinition of knowledge as the paradigm shift that resolves it.
items.summary_zh: 概述休謨的歸納難題，並呈現波普爾對知識的重新定義如何作為一場範式轉移化解它。

items.title: Modified Principles of Justice
items.title_zh: 修正後的正義原則
items.summary: Stages Sandel’s constitutive-ties objection to Rawls’s theory of justice and proposes a synthesis to resolve the inconsistency.
items.summary_zh: 重演桑德爾對羅爾斯正義理論提出的「構成性紐帶」異議，並提出一個化解其內在不一致的綜合方案。

items.title: Homeless and still free
items.title_zh: 無家，依然自由
items.summary: Engages Waldron’s “Homeless and the Issue of Freedom” on property restrictions, homelessness, and human dignity.
items.summary_zh: 回應沃德倫〈無家與自由的問題〉一文，討論財產限制、無家者與人性尊嚴。

items.title: Does natural selection explain why you and I have opposable thumbs?
items.title_zh: 自然選擇能解釋你我為何有對生拇指嗎？
items.summary: Argues that direct competition over scarce resources lets cumulative natural selection decisively shape individual traits.
items.summary_zh: 論證正是對稀缺資源的直接競爭，讓累積的自然選擇能夠決定性地塑造個體性狀。

items.title: What is function in biology?
items.title_zh: 生物學中的「功能」是什麼？
items.summary: Defends Prior’s account of functional analysis as the best theory of biological function against Neander’s teleological attack.
items.summary_zh: 在尼安德爾的目的論攻擊之下，為普賴爾的功能分析進路辯護，視之為最佳的生物功能理論。

items.title: Locutionary and Illocutionary Acts
items.title_zh: 言內行為與言外行為
items.summary: Term paper defending Austin’s locutionary/illocutionary distinction against Searle’s challenge, with counterexamples from coded speech and brain injury.
items.summary_zh: 學期論文：以代碼語言與腦損傷造成的例子作反例，為奧斯汀的言內／言外之分辯護，回應塞爾的挑戰。
